title: Jim Ryder tried to transfer UFO to Bigelow

tellings.quote: then you have the speech from Jim Ryder, who's a Lockheed Martin Space Systems guy who we now know tried to transfer a quote-unquote UFO to Bigelow Aerospace in 2008 according to Lou Elizondo, a bunch of other people.

plain: In 2008, a man named Jim Ryder from Lockheed Martin Space Systems, part of a large American defence company, is said to have tried to hand over a "UFO" to Bigelow Aerospace, a private space company. Jesse Michels repeats this as something "we now know" from Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who speaks publicly about UFOs, and from others, and links it to a speech Ryder gave. If true, it would mean a defence contractor held a recovered craft and tried to pass it to a private firm.
